features: 4K ULTRA HD RECORDING: Captures stunning videos at 4K/30fps resolution and features intelligent anti-shake technology for crystal-clear footage in action-packed situations
WATERPROOF DESIGN: Robust waterproof casing allows underwater filming up to 30 metres deep, suitable for swimming, diving, and water sports
WIDE-ANGLE COVERAGE: 170-degree wide-angle lens ensures maximum field of view for capturing breathtaking landscapes and action sequences

COMPLETE ACCESSORIES KIT: This kit comprises a bicycle stand, multi functional mount clip, bike helmet mounts, and bandages, offering you the versatility to mount your camera wherever and however you choose for sports enthusiasts, Youtubers, and Moto Vlogger Riders looking to document their experiences
VERSATILE FEATURES: Includes loop recording, micro USB port, and supports up to 64GB micro SD card storage for extended filming
RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Equipped with a rechargeable Li-ion battery that provides reliable power for extended recording sessions during your adventures
MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Features Micro HDMI and USB ports for convenient viewing and transferring of your content to other devices
description: Capture your most thrilling adventures in stunning 4K Ultra HD with this versatile action camera. Featuring crystal-clear 30fps recording and a sweeping 170-degree wide-angle lens, this camera ensures you never miss a moment of the action. The robust waterproof housing protects your device up to 30 metres underwater, making it perfect for diving, surfing, and other water sports. while the intelligent anti-shake technology delivers smooth, professional-looking footage. The camera comes equipped with a rechargeable Li-ion battery and supports memory expansion up to 64GB via Micro SD card. Multiple interface options including Micro HDMI and USB ports provide convenient connectivity for viewing and transferring your content. The compact design includes intuitive controls with dedicated buttons for power and shutter functions, plus a built-in screen for real-time preview. Whether you're skiing down slopes, exploring coral reefs, or capturing any outdoor adventure, this action camera delivers exceptional performance in a durable package.
